## Your pocket document scanner & PDF hub

ScanMaster turns physical documents, receipts, invoices, and notes into crisp, organized PDFs — stored 100% locally on your device with zero cloud dependency.

### What’s in ScanMaster

- **Multi-page camera & gallery scanning:** Capture pages with live flash control, manual or 3-second auto-capture mode, and multi-image gallery import.
- **Instant GPU filters & page editing:** Preview and apply *Original*, *B&W*, *Magic*, *Text*, and *Sepia* filters per page or across the entire scan, rotate pages 90°, crop margins, and fine-tune brightness and contrast.
- **Fast isolate PDF generation:** Every scan is processed in a background isolate and saved as a multi-page PDF ready to view or share.
- **Color-coded folders & organization:** Create, rename, recolor, and delete folders, move documents between folders, or scan directly into a folder.
- **Instant search:** Search across all documents with highlighted matches, folder badges, and persistent recent search history.

### Install

Download the Android APK attached to this release and install it on your device.
